AiSDR starts at $750. We break down pricing, autonomy, and fit so you pick the right AI SDR for your team. 11x charges around $5,000 per month for an autonomous AI SDR. 11x is a fully autonomous AI agent that replaces your SDR headcount, but it's expensive, has limited pricing transparency, and carries real questions about how much of the workflow is genuinely automated. AiSDR is the stronger default for most B2B outbound teams: it's affordable at $750/month, keeps humans in control, and integrates with your existing CRM without a 12-month contract. By Rishabh Ambasta , Founder, Modern Inbound. Quick Answer Cheapest option: AiSDR at $750/month vs. 11x at $5,000+/month Best for full autonomy: 11x, if you want AI running outbound end-to-end Best for team control: AiSDR, your reps stay in the loop on every send Best value overall: AiSDR for any team under 50 reps At a Glance: 11x vs AiSDR and Alternatives Both tools aim to replace manual prospecting, but they work differently. 11x acts as a replacement for a human SDR. AiSDR acts as a force multiplier for the reps you already have. That difference shapes every pricing and risk tradeoff on this page. Tool Starting Price Best For Standout Feature 11x ~$5,000/mo Replacing SDR headcount Fully autonomous Alice AI agent AiSDR $750/mo AI-assisted team outreach 700M+ contacts with native HubSpot sync Artisan (Ava) ~$2,000/mo Funded startups scaling outbound Built-in data enrichment and sequencing Regie.ai ~$500/mo Teams with existing sequences AI co-pilot for sales content creation Piper Custom pricing Inbound-heavy enterprise teams Real-time website visitor engagement Pricing: $750/Month vs. $5,000/Month AiSDR's Starter plan runs $750/month for roughly 1,000 contacts per month, per AiSDR's pricing page. 11x doesn't publish pricing publicly, but buyer reports and community discussions on G2 and Reddit consistently put the entry point between $4,000 and $6,000 per month, locked into an annual contract. That gap compounds fast. One 11x agent costs $48,000 to $72,000 per year. A team running two reps on AiSDR's Growth plan spends roughly $36,000 over the same period and keeps more control of the motion. For that delta, you could hire a junior SDR, tool both reps on AiSDR, and still have budget remaining. 11x's pitch is that it replaces a $70,000/year SDR salary. That argument holds only if the AI converts pipeline at a rate comparable to a human. No published benchmark confirms that's happening at scale. Autonomy: What Each Platform Actually Does 11x automates the full outbound loop: prospect identification, email writing, follow-ups, and reply handling, without a human approving any step. AiSDR handles personalization and sequencing but keeps your rep in the driver's seat for approvals and replies. The autonomy pitch is compelling until you look at the history. In 2024, TechCrunch reported that 11x was using human agents to handle tasks the company marketed as fully AI-driven, per TechCrunch's reporting. 11x disputed parts of the characterization and has made product changes since, but the episode raised real questions about what you're actually buying at $5,000/month. AiSDR is more straightforward about what it does. It drafts, schedules, and personalizes outreach. Your team reviews and approves. Less exciting to demo. Considerably less risky to buy. Data and Personalization AiSDR includes a 700M+ contact database and pulls LinkedIn activity data to personalize opening lines at scale, per AiSDR's feature documentation. It syncs natively with HubSpot and Salesforce so your CRM stays current without manual exports or custom integrations. 11x also claims personalization through its Alice agent, using intent signals and social data to tailor messages.
